cross_cutting_mbo_finding.headline_1_my_own_merged_generator_fails: s103.4's scope extension on structure.covering_absorption_directional_tell (proposed by me at G20 r1, carried into r2) makes THREE separable claims. With price visible across all four EIA prints it has now generated, they score very differently and they must be split.

the_three_claims.claim_1_SELECTION: A crowded short that is STILL ADDING (COT MM extreme + WORSENING WoW) puts the print day UP; a crowded short that is COVERING (improving WoW) does not. STATUS: SURVIVES, 4/4 per-event. 0528 (worsening) +2,100; 0604 (worsening) +1,130; 0611 (WoW +19,572 IMPROVING - generator declined) -1,080; 0618 (WoW -7,763 worsening) +520. This limb is open-time, decidable at the open, and is the only limb with clean forward evidence.
the_three_claims.claim_2_TIMING: The de-risk dates to the session's first liquid window ~06:00, NOT to the print, so the 06:00-10:30 window owns the day's largest leg. STATUS: REFUTED AS A MECHANISM, 1 of 4. Per-event decomposition (overnight 20:00-06:00 / pre-print 06:00-10:00 / print 10:00-12:00 / afternoon-to-close): 0528 = -170 / +970 / +1,160 / +140 - the PRINT window is the largest leg, not the pre-print one; 0604 = -70 / +1,010 / +210 / -20 - pre-print dominant, the ONLY clean fire; 0611 = -690 / -80 / -240 / -70 - the OVERNIGHT owns the day and the pre-print window moved eighty dollars; 0618 = -50 / 0 / +760 / -190 - the pre-print window delivered EXACTLY ZERO and the entire move is the print window. The dominant leg lands in a different window on all four days. The claim was measured on two G20 events and generalized from them; it does not survive its own next block.
the_three_claims.claim_3_MAGNITUDE: It earns a full directional catalyst leg. STATUS: OVERSIZED, and the timing error is WHY. Because I believed the leg was pre-print, I drew a path that rose from 08:00 and closed at its peak (+990 peak, +950 close). The realized 0618 shape is flat-then-impulse-then-GIVE-BACK: peak +880 at 14:32, close +520. My peak was 110 off; my close was 430 off. The entire 0618 error is a missing leg-vs-net give-back, which is the failure my own lens file already warns about - the print-window impulse is not the day.

cross_cutting_mbo_finding.the_honest_verdict: KEEP claim 1 (selection), STRIKE claim 2 (the 06:00-window mechanism), and re-scope claim 3 to a LEG that must then be netted down by the closing-phase give-back. Stated as a general rule: the COT-WoW arm predicts the print day's SIGN and gives NO information about WHICH window delivers it; the delivery window is not decidable at the open and must not be asserted. A specialist who believes he knows the window will draw a peak-shaped path and close it at the peak - which is exactly how a correct sign becomes a 430-dollar magnitude error.
cross_cutting_mbo_finding.why_this_matters_beyond_my_days: The G20 post-mortem credited this generator with 2,090 of my 3,530 blind-vs-r1 gap, and that credit was assigned from DAY NETS. The intraday check was never run. A play whose day-net is right can carry a false causal claim, and the false claim is the part that gets extrapolated to the next block. That is the attribution failure Greg's S107 framing names, arriving here from a PLAY rather than from a data hole - and it is the more dangerous source, because a data hole eventually shows up as an empty block while a false mechanism keeps producing plausible numbers.

headline_3_recorded_as_an_observation_NO.why_i_am_NOT_proposing_it: Three reasons, each disqualifying on its own. (2) The brain's incumbent daytype.surprise_magnitude records the surprise sign as NEGATIVE-TO-INERT across G6-G11 and my own lens file says the sign does not reliably sort direction; four summer prints do not overturn that, and if anything the split is a SEASONAL scope question (injection season vs winter withdrawal), which is the seasonal salience slider's territory rather than a new play. headline_3_recorded_as_an_observation_NO.the_one_thing_it_IS_good_for: ATTRIBUTION. It means part of what I have been calling a pre-print POSITIONING generator is the market anticipating the print correctly and then the print itself arriving. On 0611 the market sold into a print that came bearish and then printed its LOW at 10:30:01 and RECOVERED 200 dollars - the pre-print move was a correct anticipation and the print was the EXHAUSTION point, not the driver. On 0618 the market did NOT anticipate, the print came in line, and the crowded short covered AFTER the binary resolved non-adversely. That is a coherent causal story for both days and it is materially different from the short de-risks before the binary. A short does not buy into a binary it is short against; it waits for the binary to resolve and covers after.

MAGNITUDE, derived leg by leg: (1) overnight leg, negative and small, handed by 0617's aligned-down final phase against a session that had already delivered -970: about -100; (2) pre-print window ZERO - no leg asserted, which is the corrected mechanism; (3) the covering discharge in the print window, sized at a full directional day-scale leg because the short is at a fresh one-year extreme with four deadlines and a book thinned about 5x with the spread doubled (thin AMPLIFIES a delivery day) - the block's own week-2 day-scale is about 960 and the served n0_net_sigma_5 is 1,117, so the leg earns about +900 to the peak; (4) the give-back, the component the blind omitted entirely: the closing phase runs ALIGNED selling of -2,522, 2.6x the rally phase's net sell, into a three-day holiday seam that squares both sides - a leg-vs-net give-back of roughly one third of the peak, about -260. Sum 900 - 260 - 100 = +540. Band [150, 950]: the upper bound is the blind's number, now the TOP of the band rather than the p50, which is the honest form of the correction. Realized +520; residual +20. My blind's PEAK (+990 at 14:00) was within 110 of the realized peak (+880 at 14:32) - the timing of the peak was right and the whole 430-dollar error was closing the path at the peak instead of applying the give-back my own lens file already warns about: the print-window impulse is not the day.
days.mbo_verdict: CAUSAL READ, DIRECTIONAL AUTHORITY CONFIRMED FROM THE DAY'S OWN TAPE. absorb_session TRUE with the rally phase running -961 sflow under +770 px is a covering discharge, unambiguously - the price rose while aggressors sold, which only happens when a short is buying to close against a supplier. The blind reached the right side by the right channel (positioning) and then attached a false mechanism (pre-print de-risk) and a false corroborator (accumulation on an uncorrected b_share basis). Sign right, physics wrong, magnitude oversized by exactly the give-back the physics would have told me to draw. That is a more instructive result than the 0611 miss, because a right answer carrying a wrong mechanism is the kind that survives into the next block unexamined.

summary.the_0611_verdict_asked_for: The block-anchor absorption tell was REAL on 06-05 and it was OVERWHELMED - but that is not the operative finding. The operative finding is that it was already contradicted by the freshest reading of its OWN play three sessions before my day (06-08: buy absorbed under a falling price = arm (b) = stays DOWN), and that at k=4 with no refreshable limb it should not have carried a sign at all. I named boundary.chain_staleness_gate in the blind and then violated it - widening a band is not declining a sign. The generator I got merged into s103.4 is NOT to blame for this day: it declined on its own precondition and the decline was correct.
summary.the_generator_verdict_asked_for: SPLIT IT. Its SELECTION limb (COT extreme plus worsening WoW puts the print day UP) survives 4/4 per-event across every print it has produced and is open-time. Its TIMING limb (the 06:00-10:30 window owns the leg) is REFUTED - 1 of 4, with the dominant leg landing in a different window on all four days (print window, pre-print, OVERNIGHT, print window). Its MAGNITUDE limb is oversized precisely because of the timing limb: believing I knew the window made me draw a peak-shaped path and close it at the peak, which is the entire 430 of my 0618 error. A play that survives its author's post-mortem by not being examined is worth nothing, so: strike the mechanism sentence, keep the selection arm, and require the closing-phase give-back to be netted off the leg.
summary.honest_under_declaration: No reactive tail is claimed on either day: 0611's -1,280 print-second spike is excluded from the p50 (I forecast the close, not the excursion) and 0618's +880 peak is drawn at +730. 0611 sits 30 under the actual; 0618 sits 20 over a give-back-netted number, inside a band whose upper bound is the blind's own value.
summary.single_largest_transferable_lesson: On both of my days the instrument my lens file points at 10:30 should have been pointed somewhere else - at 20:00 on 0611, where the overnight was 64 percent of the day, and at 11:06 on 0618, where the print window was 100 percent of it. The EIA print day does not have a stable delivery window. What it has is a stable SIGN mechanism (positioning conviction, confirmed by phase absorption) and an unstable timing, and I have been asserting the timing.
